title: Servepath Speedometer: unified latency comparison board (stream vs non-stream)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Build a unified ‘Speedometer’ latency dashboard that lets engineering and SRE teams compare p50/p95/p99 across model families and routes with an explicit streaming vs non-streaming split. The board should make it fast to: 1) identify regressions introduced by model upgrades or kernel changes, 2) correlate tail spikes with trace hooks and error rates, and 3) pivot by customer, route, request-shape, and servepath. This ticket covers UX spec, metrics and logs pipeline transforms, instrumentation changes to tracing hooks, and initial alerting thresholds.

Scope in this ticket:
- Dashboard panels and queries for p50/p95/p99 with streaming/non-streaming breakdowns
- Heatmap & cohort slicer for request shapes (prompt len / tokens / conversation size)
- Waterfall panel that correlates span timings with route-level percentiles
- Trace hook links from slow cohorts directly into tracing UI
- Metrics pipeline transform to emit pre-aggregated percentile metrics and streaming-flag tag

Out of scope: long-term anomaly detection model and migration of old dashboards (will be follow-up tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for selected routes and model families and toggles streaming vs non-streaming
Each latency panel supports time-range, model-family, and customer filters and persists queries as dashboard state
Metrics pipeline emits a streaming=true/false tag on request latency metrics and pre-aggregates histograms used for percentiles
Trace links present for cohort rows with >1s p95 and open the distributed trace in the tracing UI with a filter by request id
Playbook documented: steps to triage a latency spike, related dashboards, and immediate mitigations
Unit & integration tests for pipeline transform and frontend queries included in PRs
tasks: Frontend: design dashboard layout and panels (heatmap, cohort slicer, waterfall, percentile timeseries)
Frontend: implement streaming toggle and per-route comparisons with model-family grouping
Backend: add streaming flag to metrics exporter and enrich spans with route and model_family tags
Metrics pipeline: add transform to generate histogram aggregates and p50/p95/p99 derived metrics
Tracing: add trace hook that maps request_id -> dashboard cohort link; ensure sampling preserves slow cohorts
Alerts: add SLI rules for p95 and p99 regressions and create alert runbooks
QA: synthetic load test for mixed streaming/non-stream workloads to validate dashboard signals
Docs: Confluence page with dashboard overview, filter mappings, and triage playbook
